lines: Devinjit Singh is an Investor Selling Shareholder in the offer for sale, selling up to 6,750 shares, with proceeds of up to ₹0.91 crore if all offered shares are sold.
The gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and the money has been in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), which makes this a timely call.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at the offer price. Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings were found in one section only (promoter_holding).
